```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 14_anova_omnibus_check
title: What has the ANOVA told us so far?
questions:
  - id: significant_omnibus
    type: multiple-choice
    prompt: >
      Our three-group ANOVA is significant. Before doing any follow-up
      comparisons, which conclusion does that support?
    options:
      - text: Every population mean differs from every other.
      - text: At least one population mean differs from another.
        correct: true
      - text: The radioactive-bite population mean differs from both others.
    explanation: >
      The overall test gives evidence of a difference somewhere. It doesn't
      identify the pairs, even if the sample means make one pattern look
      likely. That's the job of the follow-up comparisons.
```
